note: AI-written. Only the root module note (the one /-! ... -/ block of Becoming.lean) was changed: 17 hunks, comment text only. Line numbers in 'changed' are the new file's; 'old_line' the file's at HEAD 9e83f2c90. '/' in old/new marks a line break.

changed.decl: Becoming.ComparingCourses (root module note; board item UE9)
changed.old: alternative comparisons and their witnesses, which no module uses and C's order does not adopt (board item UE9).
changed.new: alternative comparisons and their witnesses, which no module uses and no ranking result elsewhere takes (board item UE9).
changed.why: H5 'C's order': C is a requirement on an order, not an order the account adopts. No module imports ComparingCourses, so no ranking result outside it takes these comparisons.

changed.decl: Becoming.ReachableRanges (root module note; board item UE10)
changed.old: leaf: alternative comparisons and their witnesses, which no module uses and C's order does not adopt (board item UE10).
changed.new: leaf: alternative comparisons and their witnesses, which no module uses and no ranking result elsewhere takes (board item UE10).
changed.why: H5 'C's order'. HeldPossible imports ReachableRanges but uses only Reaching.Possible, PossibleHeld and KeepsWidening, none of the comparisons, so 'no module uses' (kept) and the new clause both hold.

changed.old: exactly a widening (`Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`, `Web.paths_comparison_widens`). That widening is better is the reading of “better”, not shown.
changed.new: exactly a widening (`Web.paths_extension_iff_widens`), so the widening order meets C for every reading of `living` (`Web.paths_comparison_widens`); that courses are ranked by widening is taken, not shown.
changed.why: 'widening is better' frame. Web.paths_comparison_widens concludes Comparison W.paths living (fun l' l => W.Widens l l') for every living; the order is a parameter set to widening, not derived.

changed.decl: Becoming.Ranking (module title in the root note)
changed.old: * `Becoming.Ranking` (L1): what C ranks under each reading. Both the whole-run and the
changed.new: * `Becoming.Ranking` (L1): what every comparison satisfying C ranks under each reading. Both the / whole-run and the
changed.why: 'C ranks' (pass8 H5, critic 1896). The theorems' form is 'every comparison satisfying C ranks' (e.g. Ranking.possible_ranks, the whole-run results). Ranking.lean's own title now says 'What an order meeting C ranks', the same claim.

changed.old: formation's events as the basic tier, J1 ranks absence above malignant growth under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked.
changed.new: formation's events as the basic tier, every comparison meeting J1/J2 ranks absence above malignant growth under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C asks nothing of them.
changed.why: 'C alone leaves them unranked' (pass9b left[4], root 1905). basic_first_ranks takes Lexical.BasicPriority (J1/J2) for both comparisons and concludes better .absent .occurs under both readings; under those readings neither course extends the other (Ranking.relational_unranked; the stepwise mixed case), so C asks nothing of the pair. 'J1 ranks' re-said as the hypothesis the theorem takes.

changed.old: reading of every active event an overdrawing formation leaves the two courses unranked, so C
changed.new: reading of every active event, with an overdrawing formation, neither course extends the other, so C
changed.why: 'unranked' as C leaving a pair unranked. overdraw_unranked concludes ¬ ExtendsUnder both ways; 'C admits a comparison preferring the course with it' (requirement sense, overdraw_admits_occurrence) kept.

changed.old: * `Becoming.Significance` (L2): the continuation condition, the condition of chapter §6.15 (not asserted; Ren folded what was Part II into the theory without axiom as that conditional section on 16 October 2026).
changed.new: * `Becoming.Significance` (L2): the continuation condition, the condition of chapter §6.15 (a hypothesis where a theorem takes it; Ren folded what was Part II into the theory without axiom as that conditional section on 16 October 2026).
changed.why: 'not asserted' (frame of 9 November). The module's theorems take Unrestricted sig as a hypothesis. The dated history clause is kept as history.

changed.old: lives, and C holds on level paths with “better” read as retaining and adding what has significance. Retaining is
changed.new: lives, and on level paths the order ranking by retaining and adding what has significance meets C. Retaining is
changed.why: 'C holds with better read as' (pass9d). The theorem, under Unrestricted sig, concludes Comparison W.paths living (fun l' l => W.Retains sig p l l' ∧ W.Adds sig p l l').

changed.old: transfers C leaves mixed, and a threshold of sufficiency ties above it. Under a net weighting, which
changed.new: transfers, mixed pairs of which C asks nothing, and a threshold of sufficiency ties above it. / Under a net weighting, which
changed.why: 'C leaves mixed' (C as agent). prior_transfer compares two courses each with a formation at a higher level than the other (a mixed pair); C asks nothing of mixed pairs (07 §4.4's graded-significance law says 'deciding mixed pairs, of which C asks nothing').

changed.old: Held de se, self-concern is one from every standpoint exactly where
changed.new: Held de se, the presupposition is one from every standpoint / exactly where
changed.why: Self-concern is now a property of an order (Weighting.IncreasingInOwn); this clause is about the presupposition held de se, StandpointInvariant (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center) ↔ CentersWithin rel center, as the theorem's own docstring says. The following 'it reaches a copy' (forced_member_iff_only) is the presupposition too, as that docstring says.

changed.old: (`Weighting.every_increasingInOwn_iff_includes`, `Weighting.ended_below`), and it is C's premise where its own continuation is everything listed.
changed.new: (`Weighting.every_increasingInOwn_iff_includes`, `Weighting.ended_below`), and where its own continuation is everything listed it is being increasing in admission (`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing`).
changed.why: 'C's premise' (C as a premise). The theorem: where own marks every listed item, IncreasingInOwn items own R ↔ Increasing items R. The citation is added; it names an existing declaration in namespace Weighting.

changed.decl: Becoming.Relevance (Ranking.possible_extends_iff, possible_ranks, possible_restraint, possible_contest, possible_of_active, possible_tie, readings_rank_presence)
changed.old: of a course admit, C under the continuation condition ranks the absence of an overdrawing formation, restraint and sharing as the whole-run reading does and withholds no event; it leaves a formation that adds no possibility unranked against its absence, where both
changed.new: of a course admit, extension is, under the continuation condition, retaining and adding what has significance; every comparison satisfying C ranks the absence of an overdrawing formation, restraint and sharing above, as under the whole-run reading, and the reading withholds no event; of a formation that adds no possibility and its absence neither extends the other, where both
changed.why: 'C ranks' and 'C leaves unranked'. possible_ranks takes ComparisonUnder (possible ...) Better and no condition; the condition enters only possible_extends_iff (extension under the possibility reading is Retains ∧ Adds). possible_tie concludes ¬ ExtendsUnder both ways.

changed.old: C holds with "better" read as that `«广»`, its being better C's content, supplied
changed.new: the order ranking by that `«广»` meets C for every reading of `living`, the order supplied
changed.why: 'better read as' and 'C's content'. The theorem concludes Comparison W.paths living (fun l' l => «广» (W.admitted l) (W.admitted l')) for every living; the order is a parameter.

changed.old: The condition (scope) and C (order) stay premises.
changed.new: The condition is a hypothesis where a row takes it, and no order is derived.
changed.why: Two-premise frame. Row 8 (widens_iff_retains_adds_root) takes «续无外» as a hypothesis; rows 1 and 9 state iffs with it; no row derives an order (row 7 sets it).

changed.old: the direction on a web's moves. C read as widening on the moves' outcomes; under J1/J2 a chosen move keeps basic admissions and a narrowed move is not
changed.new: the direction on a web's moves. With every admission counted, one move's outcome extends another's exactly where it widens it; under J1/J2 a chosen move keeps basic admissions and a narrowed move is not
changed.why: 'C read as widening' (pass8 H11, critic 3159). extension_iff_widens: Extension (frame W outcome) (fun _ => True) l' l ↔ W.Widens l l'; the critic's own wording.

changed.decl: Becoming.GrammarScope («续无外则同一中心», «续无外则中心无缘»)
changed.old: with no cycle the condition holds only with one center, which nothing conditions. Past one's own
changed.new: with no cycle, where the condition holds, every standpoint has the same center, and nothing / conditions that center. Past one's own
changed.why: 'holds only with one center' (pass8 H16 b, critic 4635). «续无外则同一中心»: acyclic R → «续无外» R E center → center p = center q; «续无外则中心无缘»: → ¬ R w (center p). The critic's wording.

changed.decl: Becoming.RoutesToC (module title in the root note; board item CW)
changed.old: * `Becoming.RoutesToC` (L2, through `Becoming.PremiseWitnesses`): what would give C's order on a listing
changed.new: * `Becoming.RoutesToC` (L2, through `Becoming.PremiseWitnesses`): what would give an order meeting C on a listing
changed.why: pass8 H5 / pass9b left[4] (critic 4705); the record's title. RoutesToC.lean's title now says the same.

left.text: Continuity read one way leaves succession open
left.why: Other sense: a relation read in one direction, not a theorem's direction.

left.text: rest needs two premises the whole numbers supply
left.why: Other sense: the two premises of the law of rest over amounts (a least loss, finitely many copies), not the ethics' two premises.

left.text: The extent so derived runs one way
left.why: Other sense: the direction of dependence.

left.text: keeping widening is 全生成 there, both ways under two premises
left.why: Other sense: the two premises of a two-way representation (Steps.generation_of_keepsWidening, Steps.keepsWidening_of_generation).

left.text: leaves the two-sided pair unranked both ways (`Sides.keeping_reading`)
left.why: Exact: under the requirement 'rank only what keeps what the other keeps' neither course of the pair may be ranked (¬ KeepsWhatKept both ways); the subject is that requirement, not C.

left.text: widening what can be reached never ranks a configuration above one
left.why: Other sense: a stated relation (Reaching.Widens) never relating a pair, Reaching.not_widens_of_wider_now; not the withdrawn 'never ranks the course actually taken'. Same for 1543 (Reaching.WidensOrLater.not_covered).

left.text: its verdict there is a premise beyond C
left.why: Kept (pass8 critic's kept list: 'premise beyond C' for the lag): both orders satisfy C on the reachable-range frame and differ, so C does not settle that verdict.

left.text: no ethical predicate is asserted
left.why: Other sense: ModelStatements asserts no ethical predicate; significance is a supplied region.

left.text: a natural-number score satisfying C climbs and outgrows
left.why: C as a requirement a score satisfies: the theorems' form (Comparison.climbs, Comparison.outgrows).

left.text: C lifts, P and N hold with L
left.why: C as a requirement preserved under the lifting rule L; not C ranking.

left.text: Both the whole-run and the stepwise reading rank sharing above winning by consumption ... only the whole-run reading ranks its absence above its occurrence (1900-1904)
left.why: Reading-relative shorthand under the module's now-stated subject (every comparison satisfying C under each reading); Ranking.lean's own text keeps the same form ('the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher').

left.text: so C admits a comparison preferring the course with it
left.why: Requirement sense: overdraw_admits_occurrence exhibits an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C that prefers the course with the formation.

left.text: a commitment making matching sufficient for strict priority contains C
left.why: C as a requirement contained in another; not ranking.

left.text: the better loses no more in each class and fewer in all
left.why: Other sense: 'the better' is the configuration called better in a strict loss match (LossMatching), not 'widening is better'.

left.text: locked one way at every step
left.why: Other sense: a share locked in one direction (drawn_locked_either).

left.text: ending is ranked below by self-concern in one theorem
left.why: Kept: Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below concludes that every order increasing in its own continuation ranks it below; 07's thesis uses the same form ('self-concern ... ranks').

left.text: a generative extension never refuted to be better, C wherever it is decided
left.why: Other sense: 'better' is the Lean relation the comparison is (Priority's Better, Direction.widening_not_not_better); 'C wherever it is decided' is Priority.comparison (J1/J2 give C).

left.text: an option bettered by another is not chosen
left.why: Other sense: the comparison's relation on options.

left.text: C does not yield protection first
left.why: Requirement sense: C does not imply the lexical order (ScoreRepresentation).

left.text: constancy one way is not enough
left.why: Other sense: a class constant in one direction («有常而不通»).

left.text: what a certificate over a roster of domains warrants ... no warrant from duplication
left.why: Other sense of 'warrant': what a certificate guarantees under fault envelopes (FaultEnvelopes), not normative warrant.

left.text: a run of the regime's step moves one way only
left.why: Other sense: monotone motion of a run (also 4199 and 4269).

left.text: one course, one kind or two roles
left.why: Other sense (CourseRoles).

left.text: self-concern ranks every extension between two level paths whose admissions are listed, paths whose admissions end
left.why: Exact to Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn with its hypotheses (condition held de se, admission decided, admissions listed); 07's form.

left.text: It does not derive C.
left.why: Requirement sense; 07 says the same.

left.text: It does not derive C from anything.
left.why: Requirement sense; RoutesToC.lean keeps the same sentence.

left.text: no chooser does worse and some does better
left.why: Other sense: a chooser doing better by its own valuation (Weighting.widens_iff_noneWorseSomeBetter).

left.text: where a line persists, the web's actual levels are never a listed level path (`Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`)
left.why: Not the withdrawn 'never ranks the course actually taken': it says what the theorem concludes (¬ W.ListsAdmitted items W.level). It omits the hypotheses (only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent), as this summary omits them for the neighbouring laws; left for the coordinator if the root note should name them.

left.text: the second part alone admits one center (`«独则同一中心»`), and over what comes after two centers meet the condition
left.why: Exact, with J3's time clause; 07 §4.11's own wording.
